explanation: The incident shows that Flight AF456 was identified as a candidate but rejected by the eligibility filter. The test verifies that findAlternative correctly returns AF456 when given the cancelled flight (AF123 at CDG→FCO, 10:00 UTC) and candidates list containing AF456 (CDG→FCO, 14:00 UTC, 2 seats). Additional tests cover edge cases: same departure time (not strictly after), different destination airport, no available seats, and tie-breaking by lexicographic order when multiple flights have the same earliest departure time.
